tests.expected: Exact legacy wire bytes and dependencies/geometry across buffer boundaries; CRC, size, truncation, duplicate and trailing rejection; cancellation and decoded-budget enforcement; real TLS workflow and protocol regressions.
tests.observed: All 132 tests passed. Independent legacy writer matches byte-for-byte. Decoded model ID/author/fingerprint and physical cells including model markers and air match. Bad inputs reject. Encode cancellation leaves input reusable. Real limiter tested with shortened 65536-byte counter at 65535/65536/65537 bytes; no full 512 MiB allocation claimed.

integration_playtest: Playtest: StructureMultiplayerTest ran actual TLS server and protocol clients with synthetic profiles; server validated four rotations, empty dependency caches, overlap/cancellation, undo, late joining and restart. Default three clients: not 32 rendered clients or shaped-network qualification.

probe.method: Three warmups, 20 measured runs per operation, parent first in separate JVMs. No concurrent Maven/native checks during measurements. Construction, SHA-256 and all-cell physical/dependency comparisons are outside timing. Every encode and final decode/encode roundtrip retains the same wire hash.
probe.limitations: 64-cell, 131072-leaf, one-model synthetic CPU codec diagnostic; 192676 compressed bytes. Thread allocation is not peak memory. No traffic, latency to all clients, rendering, frame/tick or full-fixture performance qualification.

native.playtest: Playtest: production Main, real GLFW/X11 input, isolated synthetic offline profile; F12 marks/anchor/named capture, saved browsing, export/import, footprint and blocking preview, four rotations, empty-space preservation, overlap rejection, live-player collision rejection without mutation, one-operation undo, placement, export and import cancellation, malformed import atomicity, repeated placement, 32-resolution dependency and restart recovery; inventory and model editor regressions.
native.qualification: Experimental functional checks only; physical GPU and city/network budgets pending
native.source_verification: Complete set and SHA-256 values of all 220 production/harness files match after playtest. Production source/harness fixed while Main ran; no Maven compilation during Main.

media.inspection: Decoded and inspected a clear footprint/anchor/staging frame, and inspected the occupied-cell conflict screenshot with red bounds. HUD 1 FPS is functional software-renderer evidence only.
